superindo recipe chatbot
overview
A recipe inspiration WhatsApp chatbot designed to help users, particularly home cooks, discover cooking ideas and explore recipes based on their needs. It also connects users to ingredients available on Super Indo through the My Super Indo app.
background
Super Indo created this chatbot to encourage more people to use the My Super Indo app. By providing recipe ideas with links to the ingredients, users can easily find and shop for the products they need.
My role
Developed and implemented Super Indo recipe chatbot.
Designed and developed the conversation flow.
Conducted chatbot testing to ensure functionality and a smooth user experience.

how i design
Every project is different, but here's my usual approach:
01
Understand
Understand the problem, the users, and the context behind it.
02
Explore
Explore insights, identify opportunities, and brainstorm possible solutions.
03
Design
Turn ideas into functional, intuitive, and user-friendly designs.
04
Validate
Test the design, gather feedbacks, and identify areas of improvement.
05
Refine
Iterate and improve the design to create better user experience
